query: We're on Verizon with 4 lines and pay $240 a month. We live in Lancaster, PA 17601. Find us something cheaper.
expected_behavior: Asks at most 2-3 follow-ups that change the answer (device payments in the bill, phones paid off/unlocked, cable internet) or states default assumptions in one line
Checks coverage for Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile at the ZIP before ranking prices, citing carrier maps, the FCC map, or regional test reports
Fetches current prices from each carrier's own site at 4 lines and cites the source and date for every price
Returns a comparison table with all-in $/mo, $/line, effective $/mo after perks, and savings per year, plus Lowest price / Best value / Premium picks
Mentions Verizon-network MVNOs or cable options as low-risk savings because Verizon already works for them

query: T-Mobile is offering us 4 free iPhones if we switch from AT&T. Is that a good deal?
expected_behavior: Explains that free phones are usually bill credits spread over 24-36 months and that leaving early makes the remaining balance due
Compares the required plan's all-in cost over the credit period against cheaper plans with paid-off phones
Asks whether the current AT&T phones still have installment balances or are locked

query: What does Mint Mobile cost right now for 2 lines?
expected_behavior: Looks up the current price live instead of quoting from memory, and cites the source and date
Points out that the lowest Mint price requires paying several months upfront and shows the upfront total
Notes that Mint runs on T-Mobile and recommends checking T-Mobile coverage where they live
